grossesse_foetus_et_placenta | Travail p.description: Transvaginal ultrasonography in a pregnancy of a gestational age of 22 weeks, measuring the length of the cervix to rule out cervical incompetence . In this case, the cervical length is over 40 mm, which is normal. Part of the head of the child is visible at upper right. This measurement was not optimally performed, since it should be measured without any pressure on the cervix from the ultrasound transducer, so that there is only one measured distance instead of several fragmented ones.

post_partum_et_allaitement | Rétention d.description: Fragments of Gelfoam within an artery present in a D&C specimen obtained 2 weeks postpartum because of uterine bleeding. Patient had retained placenta after a term delivery resulting in post partum hemorrhage and pain. Retained placenta was diagnosed by ultrasound. D&C was planned and the uterine arteries were embolized with Gelfoam preoperatively in order to minimize bleeding from the curettage. Gelfoam, a hemostatic agent, is a sterile sponge-like material prepared from purified porcine skin, Gelatin USP Granules and Water for Injection, USP. It is intended for application to bleedin
